object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Starting from a heading with three sub-objects and a top-level object: move a sub-object under the top-level object; move the last sub-object to first; insert a new first sub-object; delete a sub-object; edit and move one object; swap two adjacent siblings; move the heading with its sub-objects under another object; and move an object whose only other change is a link review. Expected: Moved for the object that changed parent, the one moved to first, the later (at From) of the two swapped siblings, and the moved heading, but not for its sub-objects or for the siblings of an inserted or deleted object. The edited and moved object is Modified and Moved; the moved, reviewed object is Moved and Link reviewed.
